headlines.title: Protesters break into Microsoft data center site in Amsterdam
headlines.summary: Protesters have broken into a construction site of a new Microsoft data center in Amsterdam this morning. Members of the Geef Tegengas group helped organize the protest against the construction of three 85-meter data center towers in the outskirts of Amsterdam.

concept.title: AI Agents
concept.body: An agent is a model given tools and a goal, allowed to take multiple steps on its own — searching, calling systems, and acting. Power rises, but so does the need for guardrails and oversight.
concept.takeaway: Deploy agents on bounded, reversible tasks first; require approval before anything costly or irreversible.
